dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-body thoracic region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance across the primary dorsal plane with minimal gray-scale variance.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Series of faint, low-contrast linear striations visible on the posterior dorsal surface, oriented longitudinally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint linear scars/striations localized on the lower dorsal surface near the transition to the peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, dark circular blowhole aperture visible on the anterior dorsal midline.
